summary: Build live dashboards, automate KPI reporting, and improve decision speed with practical Excel and Power BI labs.
lede: Real-time dashboards and KPI automation help teams turn current data into consistent performance views and repeatable reporting workflows. This course shows you how to define dependable KPIs, prepare data, shape measures with DAX, and build scorecards and dashboard layouts in Power BI and Excel. You will automate recurring updates, design visual controls, and create refresh-ready reports that support variance analysis and clear executive communication. The course also introduces governance, publishing, and collaboration practices while addressing practical challenges such as inconsistent source data, manual inputs, approval chains, and cross-functional reporting dependencies.
audienceIntro: This real-time dashboards and KPI automation training is designed for professionals who already work with management reporting, performance measures, or business intelligence and now need to make reporting more current, consistent, and automated.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Working knowledge of Excel reporting, basic KPI concepts, and routine business data handling. Familiarity with Power BI Desktop, PivotTables, and charting is helpful but not required. No coding background is required, although participants should be comfortable working with formulas, data tables, and structured reporting files. Participants should bring a laptop with Microsoft Excel and Power BI Desktop available for hands-on labs; sample datasets and dashboard templates will be provided. The course works best for intermediate professionals who already support reporting, analysis, operations, or management performance reviews.
topics: Generative AI at work & AI copilots
